ANNOUNCEMENT BY THE CHAIR
Financial contribution from Members towards relief and rehabilitation 
works in ﬂ ood-affected areas of Kerala
MR. CHAIRMAN: Hon. Members, as you are aware, there has been a large scale 
devastation which took place in August, 2018 in various parts of Kerala due to floods and 
landslides. Heavy damage to life and property due to the calamity has been reported as 
many people lost their lives while thousands have been left stranded.
I, along with hon. Speaker, Lok Sabha, have made a joint appeal to all the Members 
of Parliament to contribute generously from their MPLADS funds and also to donate their 
one month's salary for relief and rehabilitation works in the affected areas.
Thereafter, the hon. Deputy Chairman, Rajya Sabha has also sent letters to the 
Members of Rajya Sabha in this regard. I am happy to inform you that 97 Members 
of Rajya Sabha have contributed ` 36,65,50,000 from their MPLADS funds and sixty 
Members have donated their one month's salary amounting to ` 58,69,999 for relief and 
rehabilitation works in the affected areas of Kerala.
I, on behalf of all the Members of the House and on my own behalf, express my 
appreciation to all those Members who have contributed for this noble cause. I also take 
this opportunity to request other Members to contribute generously from their MPLADS 
funds and also to donate their one month's salary for relief and rehabilitation works in the 
flood affected areas of Kerala. This money would be sent to the Government of Kerala 
for proper utilisation of the same and for taking care of the relief and rehabilitation 
programme of the people of Kerala.
